headline: Convenience pressure intensified: Red Baron launched a 5-minute microwave pizza, Factor moved into 800+ Target stores, and mainstream retailers are scaling sourdough, fresh-perimeter and prepared-food cues.

items: Market intel is current through 2026-09-11 with four available daily reports for ISO week 37.
Sourdough is getting mainstream validation: The Rustik Oven launched 12-hour fermentation sourdough bagels nationally at Kroger, Walmart and other major retailers.
Premium/natural channels still have momentum: Sprouts reached about 490 stores in 25 states, and UNFI reported fiscal 2026 natural sales up 7% while conventional sales declined more than 11%.
Hospitality reputation baseline remains strong in data/reviews.json: Google ratings are 4.4 Merriment Social, 4.5 Third Coast Provisions, 4.5 Flourchild Pizza and 4.7 The Loon Room.
Speed is now a direct frozen-pizza battleground: Red Baron Crunchtime is a 10-inch multi-serve pizza with a 5-minute microwave cook time and $5.99 SRP.
Fresh/refrigerated meals are taking national retail space: Factor expanded from a 70+ store Target pilot to more than 800 Target stores in 47 states.
Large CPG is moving toward the perimeter: PepsiCo cited a $271B annual store-perimeter opportunity and said perimeter trips grew 15% faster than center-store visits in 2025.
Frozen pizza occasions are fragmenting into snackable formats: Farm Rich launched Pepperoni Pizza Roll-Ups nationally at $4.95 SRP.
Pressure-test Real Dough packaging, PDPs and ads against the new speed benchmark: make prep time, crust quality and why-it-is-worth-the-wait explicit.
Build a buyer slide on defensible sourdough: Wisconsin origin, fermentation/process proof, texture outcome and how Real Dough differs from mass sourdough claims.

Brief agency to frame creative around three shopper jobs: fast weeknight dinner, better-than-takeout quality and credible sourdough craft. Do not claim paid/social winners until the current analytics source is wired into this repo.
Track Target, Kroger, Walmart, Sprouts and Albertsons as priority retail context; this week's intel shows each is relevant to frozen, fresh, natural or emerging-brand placement.

agency_brief.what_worked: The strongest defensible territory is credible sourdough craft tied to a clear meal occasion. Retailers and shoppers are responding to freshness, fermentation, natural-channel differentiation and convenient prepared-food formats.
agency_brief.what_didnt: Generic premium language is weaker this week. Competitors are making specific claims around speed, price, national availability, fermentation time, protein/fiber and refrigerated freshness.
agency_brief.recommendation: Make Real Dough's sourdough proof and usage case impossible to miss: lead with Wisconsin sourdough, premium frozen convenience, prep expectations and sensory payoff. Separate brand craft from commodity sourdough now that mass retail is using the claim.
agency_brief.competitive_context: Red Baron is attacking speed with 5-minute microwave pizza; Factor is attacking convenience from refrigerated Target doors; Farm Rich is attacking snack occasions; The Rustik Oven is mainstreaming sourdough claims; PepsiCo, Sprouts, UNFI, Big Y and Redner's all point to fresh, natural and prepared-food positioning gaining retail energy.
